repo_notes.content: A starter template. Schema-first is the organising decision: the schema under src/schema/ drives the resolver types.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: Dataloaders and subscriptions are the two subsystems people get wrong; give each its own page.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

pages.title: Server Architecture
pages.purpose: The schema-first design: how the schema, resolvers and generated types relate, and how the server is assembled and configured.

pages.title: Schema
pages.purpose: The type definitions under src/schema/: the domain model, how the schema is composed from modules, and the code generation step.

pages.title: Resolvers
pages.purpose: The resolvers under src/resolvers/: the resolver signature, context, error handling, and the boundary to the service layer.

pages.title: Dataloaders
pages.purpose: The dataloaders under src/dataloaders/: the N+1 problem they solve, batching and caching semantics, and per-request lifetime.

pages.title: Subscriptions
pages.purpose: Real-time subscriptions under src/subscriptions/: transport, the pub/sub backend, and connection lifecycle.

pages.title: Authentication and Middleware
pages.purpose: The auth flow and the middleware chain under src/middleware/, including how a resolver learns who is asking.

pages.title: Examples and Testing
pages.purpose: The basic-queries, auth-flow and subscriptions examples, and the Vitest suite under tests/unit.
